notes: A downloaded song no longer stops when you leave the app or turn the screen off: it asks the phone for the same hold a conversion gets, so Android stops freezing the page behind your music.

The controls outside the app now act on the song that is really making sound, including a song played online, and a song paused by another app comes straight back instead of leaving the last downloaded song playing.
A call now silences a song played online as well, and ten minutes with the screen off no longer shuts down the keep-alive behind a song that is still playing.
